title: fix(app-shell): the object page keeps its list options identity across re-renders that change nothing
body:
Fixes #10046

## What was measured first (the card asked for the producer, not a guess)

The shipped producer is `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx`, inside `renderListView`: the `fullSchema` literal's `options:` bag (`kanban: kanbanViewOptions(viewDef, objectDef)`, `timeline`, `map`, `gallery`, `gantt`, `tree`, `chart`) is a fresh object on every call. `plugin-view`'s `ObjectView` calls `renderListView` on every one of its renders (`if (renderListView) { return renderListView({ ... }) }` in `renderContent`). `ListView` names `(schema as any).options` by identity in its fetch-effect dependency list, so every host re-render re-issued the identical `dataSource.find`.

Measured through the real host (real app-shell `ObjectView`, real `plugin-view` `ObjectView`, real `plugin-list` `ListView`, counting `dataSource.find`; the host re-render is forced by a route change or a parent state bump):

| step | list queries before | after |
|:--|--:|--:|
| mount (the page's own `$top: 0` record-count probe lands and re-renders the page) | 2 | 1 |
| open a record (`?recordId=`) then close it | 4 | 0 |
| two parent re-renders that change nothing | 2 | 0 |
| view switch, each way (control) | 1 | 1 |

Attribution: on every extra render, the only fetch dependency whose identity moved was `options` (a per-key identity diff of the schema `ListView` received). A probe variant that kept `options` when content-equal removed every extra query and nothing else.

### The card's framing is partly off, and that is reported, not smoothed over

The card says the extra request comes **on a view switch**. In this shipped host it cannot: the `ListView` `key` is objectName + active view id + refresh key, so a switch **remounts** the list, and the one query it issues is the mount fetch. The duplicate comes from **host re-renders that leave the view alone**. Opening and closing a record is the most common of those, and it cost four identical round trips. The view-switch case is therefore a control in the pin, green in both worlds.

## The fix, at the producer (objectui#4567's ruling kept intact)

`ListView.tsx` is untouched: its by-identity dependency stays as objectui#4567 ruled it. In `renderListView`, after `fullSchema` is built, the page keeps the previously handed-over `options` object while the new one is **value-equal**, and hands over the new object otherwise:

- The comparison is structural and never serialises: primitives, `Date`, arrays and plain objects are compared; anything else (functions, `Map`, class instances) counts as changed. It is a module-local copy of `plugin-view`'s `isStructurallyEqual` (`stableIdentity.ts`, objectui#6460). That function is not exported, and exporting it would publish a new name (Clause-② for this card is `no`). Every uncertainty answers "not equal", which means a refetch. So it can only remove a redundant query and can never hold back a needed one.
- The holder is a `useRef`, **not** a `useMemo` (AGENTS.md #10). A memo discard cannot move it, and the value comparison decides what counts as a real change, not the ref's identity. No `useMemo`/`useCallback` result sits under `ListView`'s dependency.
- `fullSchema`'s literal shape is unchanged (a reassignment after the literal), so `ObjectView.relayRungCensus-7559.test.ts` still parses the `options` rungs.

objectui#4567's "+ Add field" live-dependency pin is on the Studio host (`renderStudioGridList`), which this change does not touch. That pin is `StudioDesignSurface.gridColumns.test.tsx`, *"a fresh columns array of EQUAL content still refetches — identity-churn liveness"*. It is green in the run below.

## Tests (all on head `af924d4`, after the `origin/main` merge)

- New pin `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.hostRerenderRefetch-10046.test.tsx`: 5 cases, three FIX and two CONTROL.
- `pnpm exec vitest run` over the 30 `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.*test.*` files plus `StudioDesignSurface.gridColumns.test.tsx` and `StudioDesignSurface.gridRefresh.test.tsx`: **Test Files 32 passed (32), Tests 355 passed (355)**, exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, after building the `@object-ui/app-shell^...` closure): exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell lint`: exit 0, 0 errors (warnings only, and the lint workflow sets no `--max-warnings`).
- `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `check-changeset-no-major.mjs`: all exit 0.
- Declared narrowing: the whole `packages/app-shell/` suite did not fit the 10-minute foreground cap on the shared box (timed out at 560s with 2 workers, so NOT MEASURED locally). The full suite belongs to CI.

### Reverse verification (both directions; the fix was committed first; mutation via `ablation-replace.mjs`; restore proven by blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`)

- **Fix reverted** (the value comparison forced false): the three FIX cases turned red with `expected 2 to be 1`, `expected 4 to be +0` and `expected 2 to be +0`. The two controls stayed green.
- **Fix over-applied** (keep the held bag no matter what arrives): only the real-change control turned red, with `expected 0 to be greater than or equal to 1`. The other cases stayed green.
- The first reverse run measured 4 red / 1 green, not the predicted 3/2. The real-change control then asserted an exact count, which is a fix limb. It was also blind to over-application, because the fixture swap rebuilt `schema.columns`, and that alone earned the refetch. Both problems are fixed: the control now asserts at least one refetch, and one shared column array is used. The pin header records the prediction unedited next to the measurement.

## Acceptance notes

- `perms` in the test mock: the existing object-page harnesses mock `usePermissions` with a fresh object per call. With the real `ListView` mounted, that loops the fetch (thousands of queries in one test), because `perms` is in the same dependency list. The pin gives the mock stable identities and says why. This is a test-harness trap, not a product defect: the harnesses that have it stub `ListView`.
- Sibling hosts `InterfaceListPage.tsx` and `ObjectDataPage.tsx` build their `ListView` schema with `useMemo`. That is the AGENTS.md #10 latent-hazard shape (identity rests on a memo), but nothing here measured a duplicate from it. It is an observation and is not filed. Owner: none.
- The equality helper now exists twice (in `plugin-view` and in this file). Merging them into one shared export would be a published-surface change, which is outside this card. Owner: none.
